2026.description: Commemorates the Buddha's first visit to Sri Lanka.
Marks the first Buddhist council and the appointment of the two chief disciples.
Commemorates the Buddha's first visit to his family after enlightenment.
Marks the Buddha's second visit to Sri Lanka.
The most sacred poya — commemorates the Buddha's birth, enlightenment, and parinibbana.
Marks the introduction of Buddhism to Sri Lanka by Arahat Mahinda.
Commemorates the Buddha's first sermon and the Esala Perahera in Kandy.
Marks the beginning of the Vas retreat for monks.
Commemorates the Buddha's establishment of the order of nuns.
Marks the end of the Vas retreat and beginning of the Kathina ceremony.
Commemorates the appointment of the first 60 arahants as Buddhist missionaries.
Marks the arrival of Sanghamitta Theri with the sacred Bo tree sapling.
